sources.title: UU Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (JDIH Kemenkeu copy)

payload.note: No new Domain Brief items; findings feed S3 batch 2 recommendations. Turnstile Free: price Free, 'best for small to medium businesses ... most production applications', up to 20 widgets, 10 hostnames per widget, unlimited challenges (docs dateModified 2026-08-14). The Cloudflare CDN Free plan's 'personal or hobby' wording belongs to the domain/CDN plan, not Turnstile. UU 27/2022: Art. 40 stop processing within 3x24h after consent is withdrawn; Art. 41 restriction within 3x24h; Art. 43 delete when no longer needed or on the subject's request; Art. 45 tell the subject the data was deleted. The Act text itself sets no 3x24h for deletion (Art. 43(2) defers to implementing rules); press reports of a 3x24h deletion deadline refer to draft implementing rules, not verified. PDF read locally with pdftotext.

payload.q: 4 (batch 2 q1). How are fake or bulk bookings prevented? (Recommendation: at most 2 upcoming bookings per WhatsApp number; Cloudflare Turnstile on the form; at most 5 bookings per 10 minutes per device/connection; admin can cancel bookings and block numbers; tests: 3rd booking from the same number rejected, submission without Turnstile rejected.)

decisions.summary: Abuse controls on the public booking form: at most 2 upcoming bookings per WhatsApp number; Cloudflare Turnstile verified on the server for every submit; at most 5 booking submits per 10 minutes per device/connection; admin can cancel any booking and block a number. Verification: a 3rd upcoming booking from one number is rejected; a submit without a valid Turnstile token is rejected; the 6th submit inside 10 minutes is rejected
decisions.rationale: S3.q4 (delegated answer). No account and no deposit make slot squatting cheap (threat-modeling abuse case). Turnstile Free is for small to medium businesses and production apps with unlimited challenges [cite: price · https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/plans/ · upd 2026-08-14 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live].

payload.q: 5 (batch 2 q2). Who may see player data? (Recommendation: public schedule shows only Available/Taken; full name and number only for the admin; confirmation page opened by a random hard-to-guess code, number masked; price always taken from the database.)
payload.a: Setuju: jadwal umum hanya Tersedia/Terisi, data lengkap hanya admin, halaman konfirmasi via kode acak dengan nomor disamarkan, harga dari database.

decisions.summary: Visibility: the public schedule shows only Available/Taken with no names; full names and WhatsApp numbers are readable only by the admin (database row rules deny public reads); the confirmation page opens only with a random hard-to-guess booking code and shows the number masked (e.g. 0812****789); the price is always read from the database, never from the page
decisions.rationale: S3.q5 (delegated answer). Threat-modeling: information disclosure (harvesting numbers, guessing codes), tampering (price sent from the page) and elevation of privilege (public reads of admin data).

payload.q: 6 (batch 2 q3). How long is data kept, and how is a deletion request handled? (Recommendation: name and number deleted automatically 90 days after the play date, anonymous slot record kept; weekly exports older than 90 days deleted; deletion requests via the venue WhatsApp handled by the admin within 3x24 hours, then the player is told.)

decisions.summary: Retention and deletion: name and WhatsApp number are erased automatically 90 days after the play date (an anonymous record that the slot was taken stays for reports); weekly export files older than 90 days are deleted; a deletion or consent-withdrawal request arrives via the venue WhatsApp, the admin deletes it from the admin page within 3 x 24 hours and tells the player it is done
decisions.rationale: S3.q6 (delegated answer). UU 27/2022 Art. 40 (stop within 3x24h after withdrawal), Art. 43 (delete when no longer needed or on request), Art. 45 (tell the subject) [cite: regulation · https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/download/46c17b53-4a45-411c-9b76-c6799e5769fc/UU_Nomor_27_Tahun_2022%20Perlindungan%20Data%20Pribadi.pdf · pub 2022-10-17 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live · amend-check 2026-11-26].

payload.q: 1. If the app could do only ONE thing on day one, what would it be? (Recommendation: players see open slots and book one with instant confirmation; when two players book the same slot at once, exactly one wins and the other sees 'Slot sudah diambil'.)

sources.title: PP 33/2026 Pelindungan Data Pribadi: A Developer Guide (article-by-article reading of the full text)
Hukumonline: PP PDP berlaku mulai 16 Januari 2027
Daftar PSE Privat di OSS: siapkan NIB dan KBLI
Cara mendaftarkan platform digital sebagai PSE di Komdigi 2026

findings: PP 33/2026: set and promulgated 16 July 2026 (LN 2026 No. 88), in force 16 January 2027 (Pasal 225).
Rights requests: correction (Pasal 71), access (Pasal 77), stop after consent withdrawal (Pasal 92), restriction (Pasal 99), each within 3x24 hours of receiving the request.
Record of processing activities with minimum fields (Pasal 74(2)); privacy by design and data minimisation by default (Pasal 123, 124).
Breach: notice within 3x24 hours to data subjects and the agency with minimum contents and a contact (Pasal 114); incident documentation (Pasal 116) and a written incident policy (Pasal 117).
DPO only for public service, large-scale monitoring or large-scale specific data (Pasal 142); DPIA only for the high-risk cases of Pasal 120.

Cross-border transfer (Pasal 160-165): mapped transfer, minimised data, a legal instrument and an effectiveness check before transfer; tiers: equivalent country, adequate and binding protection, then consent.
The supervisory agency is not yet established; Pasal 223 allows processing meanwhile when it does not contradict the regulation.

PSE: every PSE Lingkup Privat must register, through the OSS application (pse.komdigi.go.id, primary). Third-party guides: an active NIB with a fitting KBLI is required first; filed under PB-UMKU in OSS; no fee; documents commonly asked: NIB, KTP of the person in charge, domain, screenshots, privacy policy, terms and conditions. No official processing time found. One source mentions Permenkomdigi 15/2025 (not verified).
payload.note: Official PP 33/2026 PDF not reachable on peraturan.bpk.go.id or jdih.setneg.go.id today; the facts rest on two independent fresh secondary sources. Re-read the signed text and check Permenkomdigi 15/2025 at S9.

decisions.summary: Submit and lookup limits (5 per 10 minutes per device/connection) are counted in an attempts table keyed by an HMAC-SHA-256 of the connection IP with a server secret; the raw IP is never stored and rows are deleted after 24 hours by the daily job
